TARGET “Two or more WAR DOG units from your army within Engagement Range of the same enemy unit” decides when it can be used, and the gist drops it: “your WAR DOG units” reads as all of them. The fix keeps the TARGET condition and the EFFECT's own words.

fix.gist: Two or more of your WAR DOG units within Engagement Range of the same enemy unit: until the end of the phase, they can only target one enemy unit within Engagement Range of them, but their attacks score a Critical Hit on an unmodified hit roll of 5+.
